source: Standard viewer Protomaps20261008 and Mapzen/USGS terrain extract cardiff_castle
selectionRule: Keep/site and selected building/curtain polygons control exterior plan. Component roles and untagged heights/roofs are approximate picture-led correspondence. Trees, exact animal sculptures, city, interiors and underground shelters are excluded.
componentControlMethod: Union of all current standard PMTiles tile fragments for each selected component ID, retaining mapped holes; cardinal authoring coordinates rotate by frame heading at export.
